description: A late source join reaches an existing dependent item and its saved failure (engine §4.2).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text w B
%rule w s
%rule s a | b
%rule b b1
%conditions ¬$.followed-by(B)
%rule a A
%conditions ¬$.followed-by(B)
%rule b1 b2
%rule b2 b3
%rule b3 b4
%rule b4 A
